0.comment: Uncle Tian: The Tianshu and the Qixing
0.content: The Tianshu is one of the Liyue Qixing, responsible for policymaking. Historically the Tianshu seldom appears in public and works behind the scenes, planning and advising, so a public selection is unsuitable. The incumbent recommends a successor in discretion, and the other Qixing approve. Uncle Tian hides in plain sight: only a few people in key posts know. In the Sea of Clouds, Sea of People story (1.2) Ganyu introduces him to the Traveler and asks for discretion; he says he likes his life without an armed escort.

1.comment: Uncle Tian: Zhiyi and the poison
1.content: Feeling his strength fade, Uncle Tian chose to find a successor and asked Yelan to assess three candidates he had mentored: Zhiyi, Mingbo and Qianwei. Yelan announced Zhiyi as the pick as a ploy to lower his guard, having learned he was poisoning Tian through fish soup. A Fatui agent, Yusupov, had supplied the slow poison and promised support; Zhiyi poisoned Yusupov's wine in turn. Yelan arrested them, and Baizhu produced an antidote. Tian says Baizhu's regimen will take two or three years to full recovery. He admits he had doubts about Zhiyi, but wanted to trust him; before that, Zhiyi seemed only a fishing friend. Yelan told him Zhiyi was unsuitable and that Qianwei and Mingbo had potential.

2.content: Huixin, a Qixing secretary, is his daughter. Yundan, his older sister, lives in Qingce Village and cares for the village's children. Tian says he left Qingce with her to work in the harbor, and always asks travellers to tell Yundan he is alive. In the Ganyu quest he used his own old tactic, pitting two rival merchants against each other, to help Huixin with an audit.

3.content: Jiang is a boy whose Millelith parents have died. A man he knows as 'Uncle Tian', a distant relative, brings him food and checks on him. According to the wiki, Tian erected the graves and visits regularly, though Jiang does not know his parents are dead.
